production.note: One US model year, 2016. Stuttcars (Mark Leofe Capayas, 'Porsche Of The Day: 2016 Porsche Cayman GT4'): 'Produced in limited numbers for just one year'. Car and Driver's panel ('2016 Porsche Cayman GT4', cd-2016-cayman-gt4) and MotorWeek's road test ('2016 Porsche Cayman GT4', motorweek-2016-cayman-gt4) both name the 2016 model year. The 982-generation successor arrived for 2020 (porsche-718-cayman-gt4-982 record). No Porsche page was opened for the years.

body.note: C/D panel: '2-door hatchback' (rear hatch); the guide files such cars as Coupe.

configuration.note: C/D panel: 'DOHC 24-valve flat-6, aluminum block and heads, direct fuel injection'.

displacementL.note: 3,800 cc (C/D panel: 'Displacement 232 in3, 3800 cm3'); MotorWeek: 'the same 3.8-liter Boxer-6 found in the Carrera S'.

aspiration.note: Inferred: the panel describes a 'DOHC 24-valve flat-6' with no turbocharger or supercharger (C/D names forced induction where present).

fuel.note: Inferred from the panel's description ('direct fuel injection' gasoline flat-6).

transmission.note: MotorWeek: 'the GT4 is fitted only with a manual transmission, though it's a beefed up 6-speed'; C/D panel: '6-speed manual'; Stuttcars: it 'came exclusively' with a '6-speed manual transmission'.

powerHp.note: Quote: "Power" / "385 hp @ 7400 rpm" (C/D specification panel, maker's rating as C/D lists it). MotorWeek: '385-horsepower and 309 lb-ft. of torque' (motorweek-2016-cayman-gt4). No Porsche page was opened.

weightLb.note: 2016 coupe with the 6-speed manual (the only transmission). Car and Driver road-test curb weight (owner decision 9 October 2026: accepted at weight step 2; it is the measured test car). Quote: "Curb weight: 3050 lb". Test car optioned (as tested $104,815 vs base $85,595). Stuttcars' article text says the car 'weighed just 2,954 pounds' (stuttcars-2016-cayman-gt4); that is not labelled curb and is a single article, so it does not qualify (see discrepancies). No Porsche US curb weight was found.

discrepancies.reason: Car and Driver's road-test curb weight of an optioned test car vs an unlabelled weight in Stuttcars' article text ('weighed just 2,954 pounds').
discrepancies.resolution: Used 3,050 lb: the C/D panel is a step-2 curb weight; the Stuttcars figure is not labelled curb and is a single article. A Porsche US curb weight would replace both.
